Class: one bold chunky item sprite of a single small magical thing for a turn-based strategy game map, with a big simple silhouette, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat solid colours with one shadow tone, very few details; it must read at a glance at 40 pixels. The item floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it.
